scientific_scope: Corrected source/design gate after P4-v1 open-arena development closure. Poissonnier 2026 Experiment 2 Y-maze remains scientifically useful as a separate-apparatus consistency audit for the frozen P4-v1 mechanism and parameter triplet, but it is not a blind, preregistered, or promotion-grade validation holdout because aggregate, condition-level, and pheromone-side Y-maze outcome summaries were already materialized in generic repository reference artifacts before this gate and were explicitly loaded during correction of PR #44. This gate does not authorize Y-maze fitting, parameter changes, selective pass/fail thresholding, canonical promotion, or any claim of external validation.

development_result_lineage.development_policy_scope: Experiment 1 open-arena only; Y-maze access not authorized; semantic response target fixed to reference/poissonnier2026_pheromone_response_targets.json

selected_cross_apparatus_source.study: Poissonnier et al. 2026, Pheromone trail following is not modulated by previous visit to food location, distance travelled, or travel direction in the ant Lasius niger

apparatus_and_methods_metadata.primary_behavioral_form: binary choice of pheromone-marked arm versus DCM arm
apparatus_and_methods_metadata.published_analysis_family: binomial choice model with direction, experience, pheromone side, and colony structure
apparatus_and_methods_metadata.reason_no_validation_threshold: Outcome summaries are already known/materialized; a newly chosen pass threshold would be post-outcome and therefore cannot support a prospective validation claim.

blinding_and_contamination_record.contamination_consequence: Experiment 2 may be used only as a transparent post-hoc cross-apparatus consistency audit with the frozen candidate-307 P4 mechanism. It must not be described as blind validation, preregistered predictive validation, external replication, or sufficient evidence for canonical promotion.

cross_apparatus_consistency_hypothesis.model_under_test: Frozen P4-v1 hard absolute-detection-gated local Weber steering with candidate-307 parameters unchanged
cross_apparatus_consistency_hypothesis.directional_expectation: A pheromone-marked Y-maze arm should receive more model choices than the symmetric DCM arm under an apparatus mapping that does not introduce direction-, experience-, colony-, side-, or path-specific response parameters.
cross_apparatus_consistency_hypothesis.neutral_reference: symmetric 0.5 arm-choice probability under a pheromone-insensitive neutral mechanism
cross_apparatus_consistency_hypothesis.interpretation: descriptive consistency only; no post-outcome pass/fail threshold

next_gate.purpose: Freeze an outcome-nonadaptive, descriptive Y-maze consistency-audit protocol: apparatus interpretation, initialization, trail-field mapping, binary-choice endpoint, neutral comparator, simulation budget, RNG/seeds, and comprehensive reporting fields. Because outcome summaries are already known, this gate must not define a promotion or validation pass/fail threshold.

promotion_grade_next_gate.purpose: Identify a genuinely independent Lasius niger trail-following source or new dataset whose outcome surface was not used in P4 development and whose validation protocol can be frozen before outcome access.

future_promotion_requirement: The same-study Y-maze may provide useful cross-apparatus consistency evidence but cannot establish external validity or authorize canonical promotion. Promotion-grade evidence requires a separately justified independent validation source with a protocol frozen before outcome access.
